title: Evaluating Prompt Robustness in Text-to-Audio Systems for Adaptive Virtual Agents and Game Soundtracks
abstract: arXiv:2603.13824v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent text-to-audio models enable adaptive game soundtracks, but small prompt changes can cause abrupt musical shifts. We evaluate MusicGen-small, MusicGen-large, and Stable Audio 2.5 under Minimal Lexical Substitution, Intensity Shifts, and Structural Rephrasing using log-Mel distance, MFCC/chroma-DTW, and CLAP similarity. Stable Audio 2.5 achieves the lowest pooled acoustic distances and the highest audio-audio CLAP similarity under structural rephrasing, while MusicGen-large has the highest audio-audio CLAP similarity under lexical substitutions and intensity shifts. Stable Audio 2.5 also shows the greatest between-seed variation in prompt-to-audio alignment, demonstrating the importance of multi-seed robustness evaluation for adaptive game audio.

translated_title: 评估面向自适应虚拟代理与游戏配乐的文生音频系统中的提示词鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 近期的文生音频模型使自适应游戏配乐成为可能，但提示词的微小变化可能导致音乐的剧烈转变。我们使用log-Mel距离、MFCC/chroma-DTW和CLAP相似度，在最小词汇替换、强度变化和结构改写三种扰动类型下评估了MusicGen-small、MusicGen-large和Stable Audio 2.5。结果表明，Stable Audio 2.5在结构改写下取得了最低的汇总声学距离和最高的音频-音频CLAP相似度，而MusicGen-large在词汇替换和强度变化下具有最高的音频-音频CLAP相似度。此外，Stable Audio 2.5在提示词到音频的对齐上表现出最大的种子间差异，这证明了多随机种子鲁棒性评估对自适应游戏音频的重要性。
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了三种主流文生音频模型在词汇替换、强度变化和结构改写等扰动下的提示词鲁棒性，发现不同模型对不同扰动类型的稳健性各异，并强调了多种子鲁棒性评估对自适应游戏音频的关键意义。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates prompt robustness of three mainstream text-to-audio models under lexical substitution, intensity shifts, and structural rephrasing, revealing that model robustness varies across perturbation types and highlighting the importance of multi-seed robustness evaluation for adaptive game audio.
